messages:
Aisha Patel: hey team — starting my first day on Platform! Quick access Q: I followed the onboarding doc but the staging Console link gives me a 403. I need to toggle a feature flag and run a smoke against the sandbox. who do I ask to get added to the right groups?

Lisa Nguyen: welcome Aisha! :wave: Can you share the exact URL you're hitting? You probably need to be in the "console-staging-read" group first. ping your manager for the access approval and I'll kick off the add.

Aisha Patel: thanks! hitting https://console-staging.redwood-inference.com/ — screenshot: "403 Forbidden — Access denied". Pinging @Matt Simmons for approval now. Also, curious about: for feature flags do I need ff-operator or admin? I only need to flip a couple flags for a smoke.

Alex R.: fyi we don't grant FF admin by default. ff-operator role should be enough to toggle non-prod flags. If you need a one-off admin for a rollout test we can do a temporary elevation (timeboxed).

Jordan Patel: hi Aisha — I can onboard the service account for CI if you need one. We use OIDC from GH Actions and short-lived tokens. Send me the repo and scope you need. For console access please include: resource list, justification, duration in the approval request.

Aisha Patel: repo is github.com/redwood-inference/smoke-tests, need read access to staging cluster and ability to toggle one flag (feature_x_enabled) for 1 day. I attached a short justification in the approval DM to Matt.

Matt Simmons: approved for 24h temporary ff-operator and staging-read for Aisha. thx.

infra-bot: Provisioning request queued (#12345). Lisa to approve elevated role.

Lisa Nguyen: approved the queue. Aisha — you should get an invite email in ~5-10m. After you sign in, go to Console -> Environments -> Staging -> Feature Flags. For logs: we use the stacking link in the access map (Access docs -> Observability -> Staging Logs). If you still see 403 after accepting, DM me the request ID from the browser console. :thumbsup:

Aisha Patel: received invite and signed in, can now see the flags list. flipping feature_x_enabled to true for smoke test. one last q — what's the rollback process if the smoke triggers errors?

Jordan Patel: rollback is just toggling back to false; we also have an automated rollback if error rate > 5% for 2m (console route -> rollouts). If you want, I can watch the run with you.

Aisha Patel: perfect, much appreciated. tagging this thread solved for me — thanks all! :tada:
